Five years ago, Lost Tribe opened the gates to a cooler party built on one idea: bring your cooler, bring your crew, and celebrate the culture that makes Carnival ours.
Every year since, the yard has taken on a new character. We set sail with Sailor. We gave the Midnight Robber his stage. We honoured the warriors with Stick Fighter. Last year, we crowned the icons at Legends Ball.
Four years. Four masquerades. One yard that keeps getting bigger.
Now Fete Yard turns five, and we are marking the milestone the only way we know how: with our biggest celebration yet.
